title.en: Spain starts evacuating virus-hit cruise ship in Tenerife
title.zh: 特内里费岛医护人员准备迎接受病毒袭击的游轮

summary.en: Medics in Tenerife are preparing for the arrival of the MV Hondius cruise ship, which has experienced a deadly hantavirus outbreak on board.
summary.zh: 特内里费岛的医护人员正准备迎接MV Hondius号游轮的到来，该游轮上爆发了致命的汉坦病毒。

body.en:
Spain has started evacuating passengers from a hantavirus-stricken cruise ship anchored near Tenerife in the Canary Islands.

Health Minister Mónica García said the operation was "proceeding normally" and that all passengers on board the MS Hondius were still asymptomatic.

They will be divided into groups by nationality and ferried to the coast in small boats. Charter planes will be on the tarmac at the local airport, ready to repatriate them to their home countries.

Fourteen Spanish nationals will be the first to disembark, then those flown out by the Netherlands, including Dutch, Greek and German passengers, and part of the crew.

Other flights are poised to leave after that, including to the UK and US. The last evacuation flight is expected to leave on Monday to Australia.

With a long camera lens, passengers could be seen wandering around on the deck of the ship, or at the windows, all in white medical face masks, as the first evacuation took place.

Several sat socially distanced on the small evacuation boat, filming and taking photos as they approached land, where they were met by officials in white protective suits.

The Hondius pulled into the port of Granadilla before dawn on Sunday, a month after the first passenger died on board.

The sun then rose to reveal it anchored offshore, with military police boats on patrol and a major operation unfolding on land to help more than 100 passengers and crew disembark.

At about 07:00 (06:00 GMT) on Sunday, medical teams went on board to check everyone for signs of the virus.

There have been meticulous preparations to receive the ship, which won't be permitted to reach shore: a security perimeter of one nautical mile was enforced around it as it approached the island.

Dozens of intensive care specialists are on stand-by at the Candelaria hospital in Tenerife in case anyone from the Hondius becomes seriously ill during the transfer. A strict isolation facility has one bed fully equipped to deal with infectious diseases, complete with testing kit and a ventilator.

"We are absolutely ready," chief intensive care doctor Mar Martin told me on the unit, where large numbers of protective suits, masks and gloves are already piled up for staff.

"We've never seen [hantavirus] before – but it's a virus, with some complications, just like we manage every day. We are fully trained for that."

The complex operation to prevent the rare Andes strain of this virus spreading is described by Spain's health minister as "unprecedented".

On Saturday, she stressed that the risk of contagion for the general population was low. "We believe that alarmism, misinformation and confusion are contrary to the basic principles of preserving public health."

body.zh: MV Hondius 游轮上第一位乘客死于汉坦病毒近一个月后，该游轮终于接近加那利群岛的特内里费岛。 格拉纳迪利亚港接收该船并帮助100多人上岸遣返的紧锣密鼓的准备工作正在进行中。 Hondius 号预计将在黎明前抵达该地区，但即使现在它也不会被允许靠岸：当它接近该岛时，将在该船周围强制执行一海里的安全边界。 一旦抵达港口，它将在海上抛锚，以确保其持续隔离。 西班牙卫生部长称，为防止这种罕见的安第斯病毒株传播而采取的复杂行动是“前所未有的”。 该活动涉及 23 个国家，经过精心策划，以最大程度保证安全并回应当地人的不满。其中包括加那利群岛总统，他表示，在所有乘客和机组人员离开之前，他“不会平静”。 卫生部长莫妮卡·加西亚周六重申：“普通民众感染的风险很低。” “我们认为危言耸听、错误信息和混乱有悖于维护公众健康的基本原则。” 周六，特内里费岛南部的一个工业设施港口的安全措施显着加强。西班牙宪兵和救灾小组都搭建了大型接待帐篷，并限制进入海滨。 一旦 Hondius 号被操纵到位，医疗队将在周日 07:00（格林威治标准时间 06:00）左右登船检查每个人是否有病毒迹象。最新报告称没有其他人出现症状。 然后人们将按国籍分成几组，并用小船运送到海岸。届时，包机应该停在当地机场的停机坪上，准备将他们遣返。 周六早些时候，内政部长表示，英国、美国和多个欧盟成员国都派遣了飞机。如果有人需要隔离，配备医疗设备的飞机也将处于待命状态。 否则，这些西班牙国民将飞往马德里，在戈麦斯乌拉军事医院接受强制隔离。完全隔离将是一项艰巨的任务——该病毒的潜伏期长达九周——而且目前尚不清楚西班牙或其他地方的人们将被隔离多久。 世界卫生组织（WHO）总干事谭德塞目前在特内里费岛负责监督下船工作，他赞扬当局对此次疫情采取了“坚实而有效的应对措施”。 它与阿根廷最南端的一个垃圾填埋场有关，该垃圾填埋场深受观鸟者欢迎。该病毒由啮齿类动物携带，并且很少在人与人之间传播。

title.en: The weaponization of shipping channels
title.zh: 航运渠道武器化

summary.en: The crisis around the Strait of Hormuz focused attention on other maritime chokepoints. Experts warn that waterways like the Taiwan Strait or the Strait of Malacca are increasingly being used as geopolitical leverage.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The crisis around the Strait of Hormuz focused attention on other maritime chokepoints. Experts warn that waterways like the Taiwan Strait or the Strait of Malacca are increasingly being used as geopolitical leverage.

Could imposing a toll to pass through the Strait of Malacca, the narrow stretch of water that connects the Indian Ocean with the Pacific, be a profitable business? Indonesia's Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa seemed to float the idea at the end of April. "If we split it three ways between Indonesia , Malaysia, and Singapore, that could be quite something, right?" he said.

He later clarified that he was not being entirely serious, after Indonesian Foreign Minister Sugiono said that his country supported the freedom of navigation and would not be imposing tolls on vessels passing through the strait, which runs between Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore.

Nonetheless, the remark raised the specter of maritime traffic being misused for geopolitical leverage, not just in the Strait of Hormuz , but in other waterways, too. "The closure of the Strait of Hormuz has forced policymakers in Asia to face questions over the security of other maritime chokepoints," wrote the Reuters news agency.

The Strait of Malacca is of particular concern. This is the most important shipping route between East Asia, the Middle East, and Europe, accounting for around 22% of international maritime trade.

But there are other issues of concern besides piracy and regional conflict. In November last year, the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) warned of this new danger.

Even non-state actors are now in a position to serious disrupt the flow of global trade, the think tank said, citing attacks by the Houthi militia in the Red Sea. Many shipping companies now avoid passing through the Suez Canal, taking the longer route around the Cape of Good Hope instead, which significantly impacts supply chains and prices.

Political scientist Nikolaus Scholik, former colonel in the Austrian army and senior advisor at the Austria Institute for European and Security Policy (AIES), believes that these are signs of a fundamental change in the geopolitical balance of power .

"We are experiencing today the consequences of a development in which individual states believe they can legally dominate strategically important maritime straits," he told DW. It would be particularly dangerous, he added, if straits like Hormuz, Malacca, or Taiwan were to become levers of geopolitical influence.

title.en: Prague derby abandoned after fans storm pitch with Slavia seconds from title
title.zh: 布拉格德比因球迷冲入球场而中止，当时斯拉维亚队距离夺冠仅差几秒

summary.en: The Prague derby between Slavia Prague and Sparta Prague was abandoned when hundreds of home fans stormed the pitch in the final minutes, with Slavia seconds away from securing the title. The incident was called a "disgrace" by Slavia's chairman, and Sparta's goalkeeper plans legal action.
summary.zh: 布拉格斯拉维亚队与布拉格斯巴达队之间的德比战在周六被中止，原因是主队球迷在比赛最后几分钟冲入球场，当时斯拉维亚队距离夺冠仅差几秒。斯拉维亚队主席称此次事件为“耻辱”，斯巴达队守门员表示将采取法律行动。

body.en: Sparta keeper Surovcik says he will pursue legal action Slavia chair calls incident in derby ‘disgrace’ The derby between Slavia Prague and Sparta Prague was abandoned on Saturday after hundreds of home fans stormed the pitch in the closing minutes, when Slavia were leading 3-2 at their Fortuna Stadium and seconds away from clinching the Czech league title. Slavia supporters breached security barriers during stoppage time and flooded the field, with some carrying lit flares and running toward the visiting section. Pyrotechnics were thrown into the stands as players from both teams attempted to leave the pitch. Continue reading...
body.zh: 斯巴达门将苏洛维克表示，他将采取法律行动 斯拉维亚主席特夫迪克称德比中的事件是“耻辱” 周六布拉格斯拉维亚和布拉格斯巴达之间的德比在最后几分钟内数百名主场球迷冲进球场而被放弃，当时斯拉维亚在福图纳体育场以 3-2 领先，距离夺得捷克联赛冠军只有几秒钟的时间。斯拉维亚的支持者在伤停补时期间冲破安全屏障，涌入球场，一些人拿着点燃的照明弹，跑向客队区域。当两支球队的球员都试图离开球场时，烟火被扔进看台上。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The passion for a championship can be intense, yet the pursuit of any earthly prize calls for discipline and respect for the game itself. When fans storm the field, they ironically undermine the very victory they seek to celebrate, showing how easily the desire for a perishable crown can lead to disorder.
reflection.zh: 对冠军的激情可能非常强烈，然而，对任何世俗奖项的追求都需要纪律和对比赛本身的尊重。当球迷冲入球场时，他们讽刺性地破坏了他们所寻求庆祝的胜利，这表明对一个会朽坏的冠冕的渴望是多么容易导致混乱。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: 'Not another Covid': WHO urges calm ahead of evacuation of hantavirus-hit cruise ship
title.zh: “不要再来一个新冠”：世卫组织敦促保持冷静，准备撤离汉坦病毒感染的邮轮

summary.en: Authorities in the Canary Islands are preparing to evacuate a cruise ship after a hantavirus outbreak killed three passengers.
summary.zh: 加那利群岛当局正准备撤离一艘邮轮，此前船上爆发汉坦病毒，已导致三名乘客死亡。

body.en:
World Health Organization chief Dr Tedros Adhanom said the outbreak was "not another Covid". Source: Getty / Chris McGrath

Countries have prepared to evacuate their citizens from a luxury cruise ship hit by a deadly strain of hantavirus that is due to anchor near the Canary Islands, as health authorities said the risk of the virus spreading was low.

The World Health Organization (WHO) briefed member states with nationals on board on Saturday on how to manage the process , advising active monitoring of passengers for 42 days from the last point of exposure.

"I need you to hear me clearly: this is not another Covid. The current public health risk from hantavirus remains low," WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus wrote in a letter to the public published on X earlier.

He said he wanted to take the unusual step of sharing a statement to address people's concerns.

"Passengers will be ferried ashore at the industrial port of Granadilla, far from residential areas, in sealed, guarded vehicles, through a completely cordoned-off corridor, and repatriated directly to their home countries. You will not encounter them," he added.

The luxury cruise ship MV Hondius left for Spain on Wednesday from the coast of Cape Verde off the west coast of Africa after the WHO and European Union asked the country to manage the evacuation of passengers onboard after the hantavirus, which typically begins with flu-like symptoms, was detected.

Usually, the virus is spread by rodents but can in rare cases be transmitted person-to-person.

The WHO on Friday said that eight people had fallen ill, including three who died — a Dutch couple and a German national.

Six of these people are confirmed to have contracted the virus, with another two suspected cases, the WHO has said.

The ship is expected to anchor near the island early Sunday morning, local time.

Local authorities have said the evacuation must take place between midday Sunday midday and around the same time Monday before conditions at sea are expected to become stormier for the rest of the month.

Belgium, France, Germany, Ireland, and the Netherlands will send planes to evacuate their citizens aboard the Tenerife-bound cruise ship, Spain's interior minister said in Madrid on Saturday.

The European Union is sending two further planes for the remaining European citizens, Fernando Grande-Marlaska added. The US and UK have confirmed planes and contingency plans were being arranged for non-EU citizens whose countries were unable to send air transport, he said.

British passengers and staff on the cruise ship will be taken to a hospital in northwest England for an initial isolation period once they are repatriated, UK health authorities said on Saturday.

US nationals will be sent to Nebraska for quarantine and...
body.zh: 世界卫生组织总干事谭德塞博士表示，此次疫情“不是另一场新冠疫情”。资料来源：盖蒂/克里斯·麦格拉思 各国已准备从一艘受到致命汉坦病毒感染的豪华游轮上撤离本国公民，该游轮将停泊在加那利群岛附近，卫生当局表示该病毒传播的风险很低。 世界卫生组织 (WHO) 周六向机上有国民的成员国通报了如何管理这一流程，并建议从最后一次接触时间起对乘客进行为期 42 天的积极监测。 世界卫生组织总干事特德罗斯·阿达诺姆·格布雷耶苏斯（Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus）在早些时候发表在《X》上的致公众信中写道：“我需要你们听清楚：这不是另一场新冠病毒。目前汉坦病毒带来的公共卫生风险仍然很低。” 他说，他想采取不同寻常的步骤，发表一份声明来解决人们的担忧。 他补充说：“乘客将乘坐密封、有人看守的车辆，通过完全封锁的走廊，在远离居民区的格拉纳迪拉工业港口上岸，然后直接遣返回国。你不会遇到他们。” 豪华游轮 MV Hondius 于周三从非洲西海岸的佛得角海岸启程前往西班牙，此前世界卫生组织和欧盟要求该国在检测到汉坦病毒（通常以流感样症状开始时）后管理船上乘客的疏散工作。 通常，该病毒通过啮齿动物传播，但在极少数情况下可以在人与人之间传播。 世界卫生组织周五表示，已有八人患病，其中三人死亡——一对荷兰夫妇和一名德国国民。 世界卫生组织表示，其中六人已被确认感染了该病毒，另外还有两名疑似病例。 预计该船将于当地时间周日清晨在该岛附近抛锚。 地方当局表示，疏散工作必须在周日中午和周一大约同一时间之间进行，预计本月剩余时间海上状况将变得更加暴风雨。 西班牙内政部长周六在马德里表示，比利时、法国、德国、爱尔兰和荷兰将派飞机撤离前往特内里费岛游轮上的本国公民。 费尔南多·格兰德·马拉斯卡补充说，欧盟正在为剩余的欧洲公民再派遣两架飞机。他说，美国和英国已确认正在为那些无法提供航空运输的国家的非欧盟公民安排飞机和应急计划。 英国卫生当局周六表示，游轮上的英国乘客和工作人员一旦被遣返，将被送往英格兰西北部的一家医院进行初步隔离。 美国国民将被送往内布拉斯加州接受隔离并...

reflection.en: The news of a new virus outbreak can easily stir anxiety, especially after recent global experiences. In such moments, the call for calm from authorities echoes the biblical encouragement to resist a spirit of fear. God offers us not panic, but a spirit of power, love, and a sound mind to face challenges with wisdom and composure.
reflection.zh: 新病毒爆发的消息，尤其是在经历了全球疫情之后，很容易引发焦虑。在这种时刻，当局呼吁保持冷静，这与圣经中抵制恐惧精神的鼓励不谋而合。神赐给我们的不是恐慌，而是能力、爱和健全的心智，使我们能够以智慧和沉着应对挑战。

verse.textEn: For the Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love and self-discipline.
verse.textZh: 神赐给我们，不是胆怯的心，乃是刚强、仁爱、谨守的心。

title.en: Suspected boat explosion injures 11 in Miami
title.zh: 迈阿密疑似船只爆炸致11人受伤

summary.en: Officials are investigating the cause of a suspected boat explosion at a popular marina in southern Florida, which resulted in 11 injuries.
summary.zh: 官员们正在调查佛罗里达州南部一个热门码头发生的一起疑似船只爆炸事件的原因，该事件造成11人受伤。

body.en:
US authorities are investigating the cause of an explosion on board a boat that injured 11 people in Miami, southern Florida.

Miami-Dade Fire Rescue Battalion Chief Juan Arias told reporters that emergency crews responded to reports of a "possible boat explosion" at Haulover Sandbar, a popular tourist location.

Eleven people were taken to local hospitals to be treated for burns and traumatic injuries, Arias said.

Officials have not revealed the cause of the explosion. The BBC has approached Miami-Dade Fire and Rescue for further details.

"We saw three people fly out of the boat," eyewitness and local boat charter Patrick Lee told the BBC's US partner CBS News.

"I just saw a lot of them with burns all over them, and I said that it's a hot fire," Lee added. "It is quick, but it's high octane gasoline, and so a lot of them got burnt and it was an explosion."

Videos from the scene appear to show a helicopter landing close to the Miami marina with emergency teams carrying at least one injured person on a stretcher.

Fire and rescue teams were joined by the US coast guard and Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation in responding to the incident.

Haulover Sandbar is billed as a popular tourist marina in Miami, owing to its clear and shallow water.
body.zh: 美国当局正在调查佛罗里达州南部迈阿密一艘造成 11 人受伤的船上爆炸的原因。 迈阿密戴德消防救援营队长胡安·阿里亚斯告诉记者，紧急救援人员对热门旅游胜地豪洛弗沙洲“可能发生船只爆炸”的报告做出了反应。 阿里亚斯说，有 11 人因烧伤和外伤被送往当地医院接受治疗。 官员们尚未透露爆炸原因。 BBC 已联系迈阿密爸爸消防救援中心了解更多详情。 “我们看到三人从船上飞了出来，”目击者、当地租船者帕特里克·李告诉英国广播公司美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻。 “我刚刚看到很多人全身都被烧伤，我说这是一场大火，”李补充道。 “速度很快，但它是高辛烷值汽油，所以很多都被烧毁了，然后发生了爆炸。” 现场视频似乎显示，一架直升机降落在迈阿密码头附近，急救人员用担架抬着至少一名伤者。 美国海岸警卫队和佛罗里达州鱼类和野生动物保护组织与消防和救援队一起应对这一事件。 豪弗沙洲 (Haulover Sandbar) 因其清澈浅水而被誉为迈阿密热门的旅游码头。

reflection.en: News of an unexpected explosion and injuries reminds us how quickly life can change and how vulnerable we are to sudden events. In such moments of trouble, we can find comfort and strength in knowing that 雅伟 is our refuge and ever-present help. Our prayers are with those injured and all affected by this incident.
reflection.zh: 突如其来的爆炸和伤亡事件提醒我们，生命何其脆弱，变故可能瞬间发生。在这样的困境中，我们可以在雅伟那里找到安慰和力量，祂是我们的避难所，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。我们为所有受伤者和受此事件影响的人祷告。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Buddhist monk arrested over alleged rape of teen in Sri Lanka
title.zh: 斯里兰卡一名佛教僧侣因涉嫌强奸青少年被捕

summary.en: A highly revered Buddhist monk in Sri Lanka has been arrested on suspicion of raping a teenager. The Venerable Pallegama Hemarathana Thero holds one of the most respected positions in the Buddhist world.
summary.zh: 斯里兰卡一名备受尊敬的佛教僧侣因涉嫌强奸一名青少年而被捕。帕勒伽马·赫马拉塔纳长老在佛教界享有崇高的地位。

body.en:
One of Sri Lanka's highest-ranking Buddhist monks has been arrested and sent to remand prison over the alleged rape and sexual assault of a 15-year-old girl.

The Venerable Pallegama Hemarathana Thero holds one of the most revered positions in the Buddhist world - the chief prelate or custodian of eight sacred sites in Sri Lanka.

He was arrested following a submission from the country's child protection authority, which had previously criticised police for not arresting him despite being named as a suspect in the case.

Pallegama Hemarathana has not publicly commented on the charges. He will appear in court on 12 May.

The alleged victim's mother was also arrested and remanded to custody after being charged with aiding and abetting the abuse.

Pallegama Hemarathana was receiving treatment at a private hospital in Colombo when he was arrested on Saturday. The magistrate determined that he should be transferred to the Colombo prison hospital.

He also issued an order to immigration authorities to ensure that Pallegama Hemarathana did not try to flee the country.

It is unusual to see Buddhist monks - much less such a high-ranking figure - arrested in Sri Lanka, where they are both politically powerful and venerated by society.
body.zh: 斯里兰卡一名级别最高的佛教僧人因涉嫌强奸和性侵犯一名 15 岁女孩而被捕并被送至还押监狱。 尊贵的 Pallegama Hemarathana Thero 拥有佛教界最受尊敬的职位之一——斯里兰卡八个圣地的首席高级僧侣或守护人。 他是在该国儿童保护机构提交意见后被捕的，该机构此前曾批评警方尽管被列为该案嫌疑人，但没有逮捕他。 Pallegama Hemarathana 尚未对这些指控发表公开评论。他将于 5 月 12 日出庭。 据称受害者的母亲在被指控协助和教唆虐待后也被捕并还押候审。 Pallegama Hemarathana 周六被捕时正在科伦坡一家私人医院接受治疗。地方法官决定将他转移到科伦坡监狱医院。 他还向移民当局发出命令，确保 Pallegama Hemarathana 不会试图逃离该国。 佛教僧侣——更不用说这样的高级人物——在斯里兰卡被捕是不寻常的，因为他们在斯里兰卡拥有政治权力并受到社会尊敬。

reflection.en: The alleged actions of a revered spiritual leader remind us of the profound responsibility that comes with positions of trust, especially concerning the vulnerable. Scripture warns of severe consequences for those who cause harm to children, emphasizing the sacred duty to protect the innocent.
reflection.zh: 一位备受尊敬的精神领袖的涉嫌行为提醒我们，信任的职位，尤其是在涉及弱势群体时，伴随着深远的责任。圣经严厉警告那些伤害儿童的人，强调保护无辜者的神圣职责。

verse.textEn: If anyone causes one of these little ones — those who believe in me — to stumble, it would be better for them to have a large millstone hung around their neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
verse.textZh: 凡使这信我的一个小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在这人的颈项上，沉在深海里。
verse.themeEn: Woe to those who harm children

title.en: How could extreme weather affect World Cup 2026?
title.zh: 极端天气将如何影响2026年世界杯？

summary.en: With the World Cup approaching, a report examines how extreme weather conditions could potentially disrupt the tournament scheduled for this summer.
summary.zh: 随着世界杯的临近，一份报告探讨了极端天气状况可能如何扰乱定于今年夏天举行的锦标赛。

body.en:
With just a month to go until the biggest football tournament in the world begins, attention is turning not just to the teams and venues, but to the weather.

Heat, thunderstorms and even poor air quality from wildfires are all features of summer across the United States, Canada and Mexico, where the tournament will be held.

Humidity may also be a key factor in any disruption to the World Cup caused by the weather.

Fifa has acknowledged that hot weather could be an issue and, as part of its "commitment to player welfare", has introduced mandatory three-minute cooling breaks in each half of every match for the tournament.

During the Fifa Club World Cup last year, six football matches were disrupted by heat and thunderstorms, including a two-hour delay during a match between Chelsea and Benfica. It prompted Enzo Maresca, the Chelsea manager at the time, to say the US is " probably not the right place to do the competition ".

In parts of the southern United States and northern Mexico, average daytime highs are typically in the low to mid-30s C (mid 90F) and can rise towards 40C (104F) during hotter spells.

When you add humidity into the equation, making it more difficult for the body to cool itself effectively, things start to feel hotter still.

One is the 'feels like', which is how your body feels the heat rather than what the thermometer says. In Miami, for example, a typical air temperature of 32C (90F) in summer would regularly feel like 43C (109F).

There is also the Wet Bulb Globe Temperature (WBGT), which assesses physical heat stress on the body. A WBGT of around 28C (82F) is widely considered a threshold at which heat stress becomes a significant concern for elite athletes.

In a 2025 study published in the International Journal of Biometeorology, scientists concluded that " 14 out of the 16 host locations exceeded WBGT's of 28C (82F) in a summer afternoon , external ."

There are six host cities (Miami, Houston, Dallas, Monterrey, Kansas City and Atlanta) where the WBGT could feasibly reach at least 32C (90F) during the afternoon which would be considered as extreme heat stress where the body really struggles to keep itself cool.

To reduce these risks, matches are generally scheduled outside the hottest part of the day, with many kick-offs taking place in the late afternoon or evening. Scotland's group C game against Brazil in Miami, for example, will have a kick-off time of 18:00 ET (23:00 BST).

Some venues, including stadiums in Houston and Dallas, also have retractable roofs and climate control to moderate conditions.

Summer heatwaves are also a common occurrence in North America and Mexico where temperatures can rise 10C (18F) or more above average, potentially pushing conditions into much more challenging territory for both...
body.zh: 距离世界上最大的足球锦标赛开始只有一个月的时间，人们的注意力不仅转向球队和场地，还转向天气。 炎热、雷暴，甚至野火造成的空气质量差，都是赛事举办地美国、加拿大和墨西哥夏季的特点。 湿度也可能是天气对世界杯造成干扰的一个关键因素。 国际足联承认炎热的天气可能是一个问题，作为“对球员福利的承诺”的一部分，国际足联在每场比赛的每半场强制规定了三分钟的冷却休息时间。 去年国际足联俱乐部世界杯期间，六场足球比赛因高温和雷暴而中断，其中包括切尔西和本菲卡之间的比赛延迟了两个小时。这促使时任切尔西主教练恩佐·马雷斯卡表示，美国“可能不是举办比赛的合适地点”。 在美国南部和墨西哥北部的部分地区，白天平均最高气温通常为 30 摄氏度到中度（90 华氏度中），在炎热时期可能升至 40 摄氏度（104 华氏度）。 当你在方程式中加入湿度时，身体就更难有效地自我冷却，身体开始感觉更热。 一是“感觉”，即您的身体感受热量的方式，而不是温度计显示的内容。例如，在迈阿密，夏季的典型气温为 32 摄氏度（90 华氏度），但通常感觉却是 43 摄氏度（109 华氏度）。 还有湿球温度 (WBGT)，用于评估身体的物理热应激。 28°C (82°F) 左右的 WBGT 被广泛认为是热应激成为精英运动员严重关注的阈值。 在《国际生物气象学杂志》上发表的 2025 年研究中，科学家得出结论：“16 个宿主地点中，有 14 个地点在夏季午后外部温度超过了 28 摄氏度（82 华氏度）的 WBGT。” 在六个主办城市（迈阿密、休斯顿、达拉斯、蒙特雷、堪萨斯城和亚特兰大），WBGT 在下午可能会达到至少 32 摄氏度（90 华氏度），这将被视为极度热应激，身体很难保持凉爽。 为了降低这些风险，比赛通常安排在一天中最热的时段之外，许多开球都在下午晚些时候或晚上进行。例如，苏格兰在迈阿密对阵巴西的 C 组比赛的开球时间为美国东部时间 18:00（英国夏令时 23:00）。 一些场馆，包括休斯顿和达拉斯的体育场，也有可伸缩的屋顶和温和的气候控制。 夏季热浪在北美和墨西哥也很常见，那里的气温可能比平均水平高出 10 摄氏度（50 华氏度）或更多，这可能会将这两个地区的情况推向更具挑战性的领域……

reflection.en: The prospect of extreme weather impacting a global event like the World Cup reminds us that even our grandest plans are held within the larger reality of creation. This verse speaks to the deep interconnectedness of all things, acknowledging that the natural world itself experiences a profound tension. It invites us to consider how we navigate our endeavors...
reflection.zh: 极端天气可能影响世界杯这样全球盛事的前景，提醒我们即使最宏伟的计划也置于受造界的更大现实之中。这节经文谈到万物之间深刻的相互关联，承认自然界本身正经历着一种深刻的张力。它邀请我们思考，在一个受造界的呻吟可能扰乱我们精心安排的世界中，我们如何开展我们的事业。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Putin says he thinks Ukraine conflict 'coming to an end'
title.zh: 普京称乌克兰冲突“即将结束”

summary.en: The Russian leader sees potential for Ukraine negotiations, but condemns the West's backing for President Zelensky.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯领导人认为乌克兰冲突有谈判的潜力，但他谴责西方对泽连斯基总统的支持。

body.en:
Russian President Vladimir Putin has said he thinks Russia's conflict with Ukraine is coming to an end, addressing reporters after a scaled-back military parade in Moscow marking the Soviet victory in World War Two.

"I think that the matter is coming to an end," he said, referring to the "special military operation" in Ukraine, while condemning Western support for the Kyiv government.

Russia's annual parade lacked the usual display of tanks and missiles, due to security concerns as authorities feared Ukraine might target Red Square with drones.

A last-minute ceasefire between Moscow and Kyiv, brokered by US President Donald Trump, reduced the danger of any attack and the parade passed off without incident.

Putin's comments came just hours after he used his Victory Day speech to justify the war.

In that speech he said Russia was fighting a "just" war and called Ukraine an "aggressive force" that was being "armed and supported by the whole bloc of Nato".

Later, when asked at a news conference about the West helping Ukraine, Putin said: "They (West) promised assistance and then began fuelling a confrontation with Russia that continues to this day. I think that the matter is coming to an end, but it is a serious matter."

Russian forces seized Crimea and parts of eastern Ukraine in 2014, then launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.

Putin said he would only meet Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky once a lasting peace deal was agreed to.

"A meeting in a third country is also possible, but only once final agreements have been reached on a peace treaty for a long‑term historical perspective, to take part in this event and sign (treaty), but it must be a final step," he continued.

Putin said he had heard that Zelensky was ready to hold a personal meeting but added "this is not the first time we have heard such statements".

Putin said he would be willing to negotiate new security arrangements for Europe, and that his preferred negotiating partner would be Germany's former Chancellor Gerhard Schröder.

The ex-chancellor is a longstanding friend of Putin, and controversial because of his work for Russian state-owned energy firms.

Last week European Council President António Costa said he believed there was "potential" for the EU to negotiate with Russia, and that Zelensky favoured such a move. Quoted by the Financial Times, Costa said he was consulting EU leaders on "what we need effectively to discuss with Russia when it comes to the right moment to do this".

As part of the US-led ceasefire deal over the weekend, Kyiv and Moscow agreed to a swap of 1,000 prisoners from each country. But Putin said on Saturday that Russia had not yet heard from Ukraine about any exchanges.

body.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在莫斯科举行规模较小的纪念苏联在第二次世界大战中胜利的阅兵式后对记者发表讲话时表示，他认为俄罗斯与乌克兰的冲突即将结束。 “我认为事情即将结束，”他指的是乌克兰的“特别军事行动”，同时谴责西方对基辅政府的支持。 出于安全考虑，俄罗斯年度阅兵没有像往常一样展示坦克和导弹，因为当局担心乌克兰可能用无人机瞄准红场。 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的斡旋下，莫斯科和基辅之间在最后一刻达成停火，减少了任何袭击的危险，阅兵式顺利进行。 普京发表此番言论的几个小时前，他利用胜利日演讲为战争辩护。 在那次演讲中，他表示俄罗斯正在进行一场“正义”战争，并称乌克兰是一支“侵略性力量”，“得到整个北约集团的武装和支持”。 后来，当在新闻发布会上被问及西方帮助乌克兰的问题时，普京表示：“他们（西方）承诺提供援助，然后开始助长与俄罗斯的对抗，这种对抗一直持续到今天。我认为事情即将结束，但这是一个严重的问题。” 俄罗斯军队于2014年占领克里米亚和乌克兰东部部分地区，然后于2022年2月对乌克兰发动全面入侵。 普京表示，只有在达成持久和平协议后，他才会会见乌克兰总统泽连斯基。 “在第三国举行会议也是可能的，但只有在从长远历史角度就和平条约达成最终协议后，才能参加这一活动并签署（条约），但这必须是最后一步，”他继续说道。 普京表示，他听说泽伦斯基准备举行私人会面，但补充说“这不是我们第一次听到此类声明”。 普京表示，他愿意就欧洲新的安全安排进行谈判，而他首选的谈判伙伴将是德国前总理格哈德·施罗德。 这位前总理是普京的长期朋友，并因其在俄罗斯国有能源公司的工作而备受争议。 上周，欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔表示，他相信欧盟有“潜力”与俄罗斯进行谈判，泽连斯基赞成此举。英国《金融时报》援引科斯塔的话称，他正在向欧盟领导人咨询“在适当的时机我们需要与俄罗斯有效讨论什么”。 作为周末美国主导的停火协议的一部分，基辅和莫斯科同意交换各自国家的 1,000 名囚犯。但普京周六表示，俄罗斯尚未收到乌克兰方面关于任何交流的消息。 近二十年来第一次...

reflection.en: The news of a conflict potentially nearing its end, with talk of negotiations, offers a glimmer of hope for peace. Romans 12:18 reminds us of the personal and collective responsibility to pursue peace, "as far as it depends on you." Even amidst complex geopolitical tensions and condemnations, the call to live at peace remains a profound aspiration.
reflection.zh: 冲突可能接近尾声并有望进行谈判的消息，为和平带来了一线希望。罗马书12:18提醒我们，追求和平是个人和集体的责任，要“尽力与众人和睦”。即使在地缘政治紧张和相互谴责的复杂局势中，与人和睦的呼召仍然是一个深刻的愿望。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Greek minister says mystery drone from a 'foreign state'
title.zh: 希腊部长称神秘无人机来自“外国”

summary.en: A Greek minister reported a mystery drone, possibly Ukrainian, found off the island of Lefkada. A Greek military source suggested it might be Ukrainian, as Kyiv has admitted to using drones to target Russian oil tankers in the Mediterranean.
summary.zh: 希腊部长表示，一架神秘无人机来自“外国”。这架无人机本周在莱夫卡达岛附近被发现，希腊军方消息人士称其可能来自乌克兰。基辅承认曾使用无人机袭击地中海的俄罗斯油轮。

body.en:
A Greek military source said the flying robot, found this week off the island of Lefkada, may have been Ukrainian. Kyiv has admitted using drones to target Russian oil tankers in the Mediterranean.

Greece  on Saturday blamed a "foreign state" for the discovery of a sea drone this week off the Ionian island of Lefkada.

"You saw a drone belonging to a foreign country that was retrieved outside Greek territorial waters a few days ago... we know what it is, and we more or less know what it contains," Defense Minister Nikos Dendias told a conference of the ruling New Democracy party in Thessaloniki.

The craft was found by a fisherman inside a coastal cave on Thursday and was later moved to a naval base on the mainland for inspection, public broadcaster ERT reported.

Military experts made the drone safe for transport to Athens after explosives were found on board, AFP news agency reported, citing a Greek military source.

The source said the unmanned surface vehicle "resembles" a Magura-class sea drone used by Ukraine's armed forces against Russian ships in the Crimea.

Kyiv has also confirmed it targeted a Russian "shadow fleet" oil tanker with aerial drones in the Mediterranean.

A source from Ukrainian intelligence claimed that one of the tankers, the QENDIL, was struck in December and "sustained critical damage."

Reuters news agency cited a maritime ⁠security source as saying the drone may have been part ⁠of a ​larger shipment or may have drifted off course after a signal failure.
body.zh: 希腊军方消息人士称，本周在莱夫卡达岛附近发现的飞行机器人可能是乌克兰人。基辅承认使用无人机袭击地中海的俄罗斯油轮。 希腊周六指责“外国国家”本周在爱奥尼亚莱夫卡达岛附近发现了一架海上无人机。 国防部长尼科斯·登迪亚斯在塞萨洛尼基举行的执政党新民主党会议上表示：“几天前，你看到一架属于外国的无人机在希腊领海外被回收……我们知道它是什么，我们或多或少知道它包含什么。” 据公共广播公司 ERT 报道，周四，一名渔民在沿海洞穴内发现了这艘船，随后将其转移到大陆的一个海军基地进行检查。 据法新社援引希腊军方消息人士的话报道，在无人机上发现爆炸物后，军事专家将无人机安全运往雅典。 消息人士称，这架无人驾驶水面飞行器“类似于”乌克兰武装部队在克里米亚对抗俄罗斯船只所使用的马古拉级海上无人机。 基辅还证实，它在地中海用无人机瞄准了一艘俄罗斯“影子舰队”油轮。 乌克兰情报部门的消息人士称，其中一艘名为“QENDIL”的油轮于 12 月被击中并“遭受严重损坏”。 路透社援引一位海事安全消息人士的话说，这架无人机可能是更大一批货物的一部分，或者可能在信号故障后偏离了航线。

reflection.en: The discovery of a mystery drone highlights the ongoing use of advanced technology in modern conflicts. Isaiah's ancient prophecy envisions a future where instruments of war are transformed into tools for peace and productivity. This reminds us to long for a world where innovation serves human flourishing rather than destruction.
reflection.zh: 一架神秘无人机的发现凸显了现代冲突中先进技术的持续使用。以赛亚的古老预言描绘了一个未来，战争工具将被转化为和平与生产的工具。这提醒我们渴望一个创新服务于人类繁荣而非毁灭的世界。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: The Australian moving to oust British Prime Minister Keir Starmer
title.zh: 这位澳大利亚人正试图罢免英国首相基尔·斯塔默

summary.en: The British prime minister is facing a fresh threat to his leadership following Labour’s crushing local election losses. An Australian figure is reportedly leading efforts to remove him from his position.
summary.zh: 英国首相在工党地方选举惨败后，正面临领导地位的新威胁。据报道，一名澳大利亚人正在推动罢免他的职务。

body.en:
British Prime Minister Keir Starmer vowed to stay in the top job despite Labour's historic loss in local elections. Source: Getty / Leon Neal

British Prime Minister Keir Starmer, reeling from a crushing local election defeat, faced a new setback to his leadership when an Australian-born former minister said she would challenge him for the top job if no one else stepped forward.

Starmer's Labour Party recorded the worst losses of a governing party in municipal polls since 1995 , prompting a growing number of his own lawmakers to call on him to quit.

To try to shore up his position in the party earlier on Saturday local time, he named two influential Labour grandees as advisers, former prime minister Gordon Brown and former deputy Labour leader Harriet Harman.

But just hours later, Labour politician Catherine West, a former minister, told BBC Radio that she wanted the cabinet to work out a plan to replace Starmer by Monday, or she would challenge him for the position herself.

"If ... there are no leadership hopefuls who come forward tomorrow, then Monday morning I will put my name forward to stand for the Leader of the Labour Party," she said.

West, who was born and raised in Australia, holds dual Australian and British citizenship.

As the extent of the defeat emerged, more than 20 politicians publicly and privately called on Starmer to set out a timetable for his departure. Asked whether he would stand down, he told British media that it was not the right thing to do.

Several Cabinet ministers said on Friday that they continued to support Starmer, who just under two years ago led Labour to a landslide national election victory, and an immediate challenge from the potential leadership rivals does not look straightforward.

Greater Manchester mayor Andy Burnham does not have the seat in parliament he needs to mount a challenge, and former deputy prime minister Angela Rayner has yet to fully resolve the tax issues that prompted her resignation from office last year.

Wes Streeting, currently health minister, is, like Starmer, tainted by the appointment of Peter Mandelson as Britain's ambassador to the United States . Streeting was close to Mandelson who was sacked over his ties to the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

Any candidate wishing to make a challenge would need to secure the public support of 20 per cent of Labour members of parliament. With Labour currently holding 403 seats, that equates to 81 backers.

West said she had 10 names behind her so far but her preferred option was that another candidate put themselves forward.

"I think there are several people who would like to do it who have been planning for months," she said.

body.zh: 尽管工党在地方选举中遭遇历史性失败，英国首相基尔·斯塔默仍誓言继续留任首相。资料来源：盖蒂/莱昂尼尔 英国首相基尔·斯塔默(Keir Starmer)因地方选举惨败而陷入困境，他的领导能力面临新的挫折，一名澳大利亚出生的前部长表示，如果没有其他人挺身而出，她将挑战他的最高职位。 斯塔默所在的工党在市政民意调查中创下了执政党自1995年以来最惨重的失利，促使越来越多的斯塔默议员呼吁他辞职。 当地时间周六早些时候，为了巩固自己在党内的地位，他任命了两位有影响力的工党大人物为顾问，他们是前首相戈登·布朗和前工党副领袖哈里特·哈曼。 但就在几小时后，前部长、工党政治家凯瑟琳·韦斯特告诉英国广播公司电台，她希望内阁在周一之前制定出替换斯塔默的计划，否则她将亲自挑战他的职位。 她说：“如果......明天没有领导候选人出面，那么周一早上我将提出自己的名字竞选工党领袖。” 韦斯特在澳大利亚出生和长大，拥有澳大利亚和英国双重国籍。 随着失败的程度浮出水面，20多位政治家公开和私下呼吁斯塔默制定下台时间表。当被问及是否会辞职时，他告诉英国媒体，这不是正确的做法。 几位内阁部长周五表示，他们继续支持斯塔默，斯塔默在不到两年前带领工党在全国大选中取得了压倒性胜利，而来自潜在领导对手的直接挑战看起来并不容易。 大曼彻斯特市长安迪·伯纳姆(Andy Burnham)在议会中没有获得发起挑战所需的席位，前副总理安吉拉·雷纳(Angela Rayner)尚未完全解决导致她去年辞职的税务问题。 现任卫生部长韦斯·斯特里廷和斯塔默一样，也因彼得·曼德尔森被任命为英国驻美国大使而受到玷污。斯特里廷与曼德尔森关系密切，曼德尔森因与已故性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的关系而被解雇。 任何想要发起挑战的候选人都需要获得议会中 20% 工党议员的公众支持。工党目前拥有 403 个席位，相当于 81 个支持者。 韦斯特说，到目前为止，她身后有 10 个候选人，但她更喜欢的选择是另一位候选人提出自己的名字。 “我认为有几个人愿意这样做，他们已经计划了几个月，”她说。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: Political leadership often appears to be a game of strategy and public opinion, yet this news reminds us of the transient nature of power. Ultimately, the Bible teaches that it is 雅伟 who determines who rises and falls, holding all authority in His hands. This perspective offers a sober view of political shifts, encouraging us to look beyond immediate...
reflection.zh: 政治领导权常常看似是策略和民意博弈的结果，然而这则新闻提醒我们权力的短暂性。最终，圣经教导我们是雅伟决定谁兴谁衰，一切权柄都在祂手中。这种视角为政治变迁提供了一个清醒的看法，鼓励我们超越眼前的结果，看到上帝的主权计划。

verse.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
verse.textZh: 惟有神断定；他使这人降卑，使那人升高。

title.en: At least 17 killed in Israeli strikes, Lebanon says
title.zh: 黎巴嫩称以色列袭击造成至少17人死亡

summary.en: Lebanon reports that at least 17 people have been killed in Israeli strikes. These latest attacks jeopardize a three-week-old fragile ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah.
summary.zh: 黎巴嫩称，以色列的袭击造成至少17人死亡。这些最新的袭击威胁到以色列和真主党之间已持续三周的脆弱停火。

body.en:
Lebanese authorities said two people were killed after a vehicle was targeted by an Israeli air strike on the Beirut to Sidon highway. Source: Anadolu / Houssam Shbaro

Israeli drone strikes on vehicles south of Beirut have killed four people, while airstrikes on southern Lebanon killed at least 13, including a man and his 12-year-old daughter, Lebanese authorities say.

The fresh strikes mark another escalation since a ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah went into effect on 17 April. Both Israel and Hezbollah have continued their daily attacks despite the truce.

Two of the strikes on Saturday, local time, took place on the highway linking Beirut with the southern port city of Sidon, in which several people were wounded, while the third happened on a road leading to Lebanon’s Chouf region, killing three, the state-run National News Agency (NNA) said.

The Lebanese health ministry said an Israeli airstrike on the southern village of Saksakiyeh killed at least seven, including a child, and wounded 15. The ministry said this was an initial count.

The agency reported strikes in southern Lebanon, including one on the village of Bourj Rahhal that killed three and another in Maifadoun that killed one.

In a separate incident, the ministry said three Israeli drone strikes killed a Syrian man who was riding a motorcycle with his 12-year-old daughter in the city of Nabatiyeh.

The ministry said that after the initial strike, the man and his daughter managed to move away from the site only to be attacked again by the drone instantly killing the man.

The girl then moved about 100m away and was hit again by the drone after she had already been wounded. The girl later died in a hospital, NNA said.

"The Ministry of Public Health denounces this barbaric targeting and the deliberate violence against civilians and children in Lebanon," the ministry said in its statement added that the strike marks an ongoing series "of grave violations of International Humanitarian Law".

The Israeli military said Hezbollah fired explosive drones into Israel near the border with Lebanon, adding that three soldiers were wounded, one of them seriously, in one of the attacks. It claimed Hezbollah fired drones inside Lebanon one of which hit an Israeli vehicle without inflicting casualties.

Hezbollah claimed several attacks inside Lebanon, as well as firing a drone at an Israeli military post in the northern town of Misgav Am.

title.en: Putin says he thinks Ukraine war is 'coming to an end'
title.zh: 普京称乌克兰战争“即将结束”

summary.en: The Russian president made remarks suggesting the four-year conflict in Ukraine is nearing its conclusion, coinciding with a three-day ceasefire observed by Moscow and Kyiv.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯总统发表言论，暗示持续四年的乌克兰冲突即将结束，这与莫斯科和基辅遵守的三天停火协议同时进行。

body.en:
The Russian president made the remarks as Moscow and Kyiv observe a three-day ceasefire in their four-year conflict.

Russian President Vladimir Putin on Saturday hinted that the Ukraine war could soon end.

Speaking to reporters after marking Russia's Victory Day parade , Putin said: "I think that the ‌matter is coming to an end."

The comment was made in response to a question about whether Western help to Ukraine went too far.

The Russian leader said: "They started ratcheting up the confrontation with Russia, which continues to this day. I think it is heading to an end, but it's still a serious matter."

Putin's remarks come as Kyiv and Moscow observe a three-day ceasefire in Russia's war in Ukraine this weekend.

The truce was announced on Friday by US President Donald Trump after negotiations brokered by Washington.

European Council President Antonio Costa on Thursday said the European Union  was prepared to hold separate talks with Russia  and Ukraine  “when the right moment comes."

During his news conference, Putin was asked to name his preferred EU negotiator for those talks. He named former German Chancellor Gerhard Schröder .

Schröder is one of Putin’s closest Western allies and a longtime personal friend. But he has faced heavy criticism at home for those ties, which included lucrative board positions at Russian state-linked energy firms.

Putin also accused the EU of seeking to escalate the conflict, warning Brussels that "this game could prove costly."

Ukraine continues to receive massive support from Europe, particularly equipment and technology.

As part of this weekend's US-led peace deal, both sides agreed to a large prisoner swap, but Putin said Moscow had not heard from Ukraine on the matter.

"We are counting on the Ukrainian side to respond to the proposal made by the President of the United States. Unfortunately, we still have not received any proposals so far," he told reporters.

Putin said he was ready for direct peace talks with ‌Ukrainian President ​ Volodymyr Zelenskyy , but only after ⁠a ​lasting ​peace ​deal was agreed.

The Russian president went on to discuss the Iran war, saying he hoped it would end as soon as possible, but if ⁠it ​did not ​then everyone ‌would lose ​out.

Russia's Victory Day commemorates the Soviet Union's defeat of Nazi Germany at the end of World War II.

Saturday's parade was scaled down, with mostly leaders of Russia's close allies in attendance and no military hardware on display for the first time in nearly two decades.
body.zh: 俄罗斯总统发表上述言论之际，莫斯科和基辅在四年的冲突中遵守了为期三天的停火协议。 俄罗斯总统普京周六暗示乌克兰战争可能很快结束。 普京在庆祝俄罗斯胜利日阅兵后对记者说：“我认为此事即将结束。” 这一评论是为了回答有关西方对乌克兰的帮助是否太过分的问题。 这位俄罗斯领导人表示：“他们开始加剧与俄罗斯的对抗，这种对抗一直持续到今天。我认为它即将结束，但这仍然是一个严重的问题。” 普京发表此番言论之际，基辅和莫斯科本周末在俄罗斯乌克兰战争中实现了为期三天的停火。 在华盛顿斡旋谈判后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普于周五宣布休战。 欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔周四表示，欧盟准备“在适当的时机到来时”与俄罗斯和乌克兰分别举行会谈。 在新闻发布会上，普京被要求提名他最喜欢的欧盟谈判代表。他任命了德国前总理格哈德·施罗德。 施罗德是普京最亲密的西方盟友之一，也是普京的长期私人朋友。但他因这些关系而在国内面临严厉批评，其中包括在俄罗斯国家相关能源公司担任利润丰厚的董事会职位。 普京还指责欧盟试图升级冲突，并警告布鲁塞尔“这场游戏可能代价高昂”。 乌克兰继续获得欧洲的大力支持，特别是设备和技术。 作为本周末美国主导的和平协议的一部分，双方同意进行大规模囚犯交换，但普京表示，莫斯科尚未收到乌克兰关于此事的消息。 “我们期待乌克兰方面对美国总统的提议做出回应。不幸的是，到目前为止我们还没有收到任何提议，”他告诉记者。 普京表示，他已准备好与乌克兰总统泽连斯基进行直接和谈，但前提是达成持久和平协议。 俄罗斯总统接着讨论了伊朗战争，表示他希望战争尽快结束，但如果没有结束，那么每个人都会遭受损失。 俄罗斯胜利日是为了纪念第二次世界大战结束时苏联击败纳粹德国。 周六的阅兵规模有所缩小，出席者大多是俄罗斯亲密盟友的领导人，近二十年来首次没有展示任何军事装备。

title.en: Tariffs or not? How EU is dealing with US 'dealmaking'
title.zh: 关税与否？欧盟如何应对美国的“交易策略”

summary.en: President Trump earlier this week threatened European car makers with 25% tariffs before walking it back later in the week. The European Union is now navigating the challenges posed by this unpredictable approach to international trade relations.
summary.zh: 美国总统特朗普本周早些时候曾威胁对欧洲汽车制造商征收25%的关税，但随后又撤回了这一威胁。欧盟目前正在应对这种不可预测的国际贸易关系方式所带来的挑战。

body.en:
Earlier this week, President Trump threatened European car makers with 25% tariffs before walking it back later in the week. How is the EU dealing with this unpredictability?

When the trade ministers of the so-called Group of Seven, or G7, nations met in Paris this week, they were supposed to be talking about the most pressing issues facing global trade, including critical minerals and the impact of the Iran war.

Instead, the meeting was overshadowed by threats made by US President Donald Trump to impose a 25% tariff on imports of European vehicles.

Trump made the threats earlier this week and has justified them by arguing that the European Union — members France, Germany and Italy also belong to the G7 — hasn't fulfilled its obligations under a previous US-EU tariff deal known as the Turnberry Agreement.

The deal was struck at Trump's Turnberry golf course in Scotland and both sides agreed the US would only impose a maximum tariff of 15% on EU goods, while the EU would eliminate all tariffs on US industrial products. The Europeans reject the idea that they haven't kept up their end of the bargain, although they have yet to ratify the agreement in the European Parliament.

Before the G7 summit, the EU Commissioner for Trade and Economic Security, Maros Sefcovic, spoke with US Trade Representative, Jamieson Greer, in Paris.

Sefcovic later said that he and Greer had "clearly concluded that it's important to respect the deal from Turnberry from both sides."

That means that the EU must reduce tariffs on US exports as agreed and the US should return to the promised 15% tariff, Sefcovic said.

Katherina Reiche, Germany's minister for economic affairs and energy, also spoke with her American counterparts in Paris.

"It is true we are making progress in implementing the compromise we reached on a tariff agreement," Reiche told DW. She added that the issue of auto exports is a central one for Germany that she hoped would be resolved via ongoing talks.

In fact, on Friday, Trump did pull back somewhat on the threat of 25% tariffs. He said he would be prepared to wait until July 4 to decide whether to impose higher tariffs on the EU.

After a phone call with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, Trump said he agreed to give her until "our Country's 250th Birthday or, unfortunately, their Tariffs would immediately jump to much higher levels," the BBC reported.

Complicating matters further is the fact that just hours before Trump agreed to wait until July 4, a US court ruled against other Trump tariffs , which would open the door for further legal pushback.

Should higher tariffs actually be implemented, the German car industry would be particularly hard hit, an analysis by the Kiel Institute for the World Economy found.

body.en:
One report from a US military command described an unidentified anomalous phenomena that resembled a "football-shaped body" near Japan. Credit: US Department of Defence

United States President Donald Trump has released a tranche of declassified files on alleged UFO sightings and extraterrestrial life dating as far back as the 1940s, in what he is calling an effort to provide "maximum transparency" to the public.

Sightings of flying saucers, discs and a "super-hot" hovering orb, as well as an encounter with a Lord of the Rings-style glowing orange light, are among the reported incidents in the FBI, State Department, NASA and Pentagon files.

The more than 160 newly released files cover incidents that, for a range of reasons, couldn't be conclusively explained by these organisations.

Additional documents will be released as more materials are declassified, the Pentagon said.

Interest in UFOs has intensified in recent years, after the US government investigated numerous reports of unusual aircraft, amid concerns foreign adversaries could be trialling highly advanced technologies.

Though the Pentagon has been working on declassifying the documents for years, Trump drove fresh curiosity earlier this year when he teased that a major UFO and alien document dump was forthcoming.

He made the promise days after former president Barack Obama went viral for suggesting aliens are "real" during a podcast appearance.

The Pentagon described the files as new and "never-before-seen", though some had been made public years ago.

Trump wrote in a Truth Social post on Saturday that he had directed his administration to release the files "in an effort for complete and maximum transparency".

"Whereas previous Administrations have failed to be transparent on this subject, with these new Documents and Videos, the people can decide for themselves, "WHAT THE HELL IS GOING ON?" Have Fun and Enjoy!" Trump wrote.

Experts have urged people to avoid jumping to conclusions when reading the files, warning that videos of unidentified anomalous phenomena, or UAPs, are frequently misinterpreted by those unfamiliar with military technology.

No verified evidence of intelligent life beyond Earth has ever been produced, and the Pentagon said in a 2024 report it had no proof that UAPs were alien technology, with many suspicious sightings turning out to be normal aircraft.

Another shows what is described as "unidentified phenomena" taken from the surface of the moon during the 1969 Apollo 12 mission.

There's also a transcript from NASA's 1972 Apollo 17 mission in which pilot Ronald Evans reports seeing "a few very bright particles or fragments or something that go drifting by" from the moon.

Proverbs 14:15 reminds us that while the naive may believe everything, the prudent take time to consider and discern. This encourages thoughtful reflection rather than hasty judgment when encountering the unknown.

title.en: The weaponization of shipping channels

summary.en: The crisis around the Strait of Hormuz focused attention on other maritime chokepoints. Experts warn that waterways like the Taiwan Strait or the Strait of Malacca are increasingly being used as geopolitical leverage.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The crisis around the Strait of Hormuz focused attention on other maritime chokepoints. Experts warn that waterways like the Taiwan Strait or the Strait of Malacca are increasingly being used as geopolitical leverage.

Could imposing a toll to pass through the Strait of Malacca, the narrow stretch of water that connects the Indian Ocean with the Pacific, be a profitable business? Indonesia's Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa seemed to float the idea at the end of April. "If we split it three ways between Indonesia , Malaysia, and Singapore, that could be quite something, right?" he said.

He later clarified that he was not being entirely serious, after Indonesian Foreign Minister Sugiono said that his country supported the freedom of navigation and would not be imposing tolls on vessels passing through the strait, which runs between Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore.

Nonetheless, the remark raised the specter of maritime traffic being misused for geopolitical leverage, not just in the Strait of Hormuz , but in other waterways, too. "The closure of the Strait of Hormuz has forced policymakers in Asia to face questions over the security of other maritime chokepoints," wrote the Reuters news agency.

The Strait of Malacca is of particular concern. This is the most important shipping route between East Asia, the Middle East, and Europe, accounting for around 22% of international maritime trade.

But there are other issues of concern besides piracy and regional conflict. In November last year, the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) warned of this new danger.

Even non-state actors are now in a position to serious disrupt the flow of global trade, the think tank said, citing attacks by the Houthi militia in the Red Sea. Many shipping companies now avoid passing through the Suez Canal, taking the longer route around the Cape of Good Hope instead, which significantly impacts supply chains and prices.

Political scientist Nikolaus Scholik, former colonel in the Austrian army and senior advisor at the Austria Institute for European and Security Policy (AIES), believes that these are signs of a fundamental change in the geopolitical balance of power .

"We are experiencing today the consequences of a development in which individual states believe they can legally dominate strategically important maritime straits," he told DW. It would be particularly dangerous, he added, if straits like Hormuz, Malacca, or Taiwan were to become levers of geopolitical influence.

body.en: The US president will be counting on China to influence Iran and help him out of his latest mess. But the price may be high – including for Taiwan Like an out-of-control wrecking ball, swinging wildly back and forth, Donald Trump smashes up the international order without much thought for the consequences. Lacking coherent strategies, workable plans or consistent aims, he power-trips erratically from one fragile region, tense warzone and complex geopolitical situation to another, leaving misery, confusion and rubble in his wake. Typically, he claims a bogus victory, demands that others repair the damage and pick up the tab, then looks around for something new to break. The president will bulldoze into another international minefield this week – the fraught standoff between China and Taiwan – when he travels to Beijing for a two-day summit with President Xi Jinping. After a string of humiliating policy implosions over Ukraine, Gaza, Nato, Greenland, and now Iran and Lebanon, needy Trump craves a diplomatic success to flaunt at home. But his hopes of vote-winning trade pacts are overshadowed by his latest war of choice. He needs Xi’s promise not to arm Iran if all-out fighting resumes – and Xi’s help keeping the strait of Hormuz open as part of a mooted framework peace deal. Continue reading...

title.en: China: Calls for death penalty after teen gets life sentence
title.zh: 中国：少年被判无期徒刑后，家属呼吁判处死刑

summary.en: A 14-year-old in China's Yunnan province has been convicted of intentional homicide and rape, and sentenced to life in prison. The victim's family argue he deserves the death penalty.
summary.zh: 中国云南省一名14岁少年因故意杀人罪和强奸罪被判处无期徒刑。受害者家属呼吁判处该少年死刑。

body.en:
A 14-year-old in China's Yunnan province has been convicted of intentional homicide and rape, and sentenced to life in prison. The victim's family argue he deserves the death penalty.

In late April, an unusual court trial in China's southwestern Yunnan province led to a landmark ruling, where a local court found a minor guilty of intentional homicide and rape, and sentenced him to life imprisonment.   

At the time of the crime, the defendant was 14 years old. It marked the first time such a severe sentence was handed down to a minor in China.

The court ruled there was enough proof to support the case that, in the summer of 2025, the defendant raped his then 15-year-old classmate on her way home from a party. To prevent the crime from being discovered, he then strangled her to death.

The judges determined that the offense was particularly heinous and imposed the maximum possible sentence. The defendant is said to have confessed.

However, the victim's family considers the sentence too lenient and plans to appeal.

"We still hope for the imposition of the death penalty so that the perpetrator pays for his victim's life with his own," the victim's father told the local press, calling for "immediate execution."

Zhou Zhaocheng, the lawyer representing the victim's family, said that the demand for the death penalty "stems from their profound despair over the loss of their daughter."

From a legal standpoint, any appeal by the victim's family demanding capital punishment seems doomed to fail. Minors can neither be sentenced to death nor be given even a suspended death sentence under Chinese law. But the case has sent shock waves across China and sparked a debate on youth, crime, and consequences .

Reports on juvenile crime are rare in China. According to a report by the official Xinhua News Agency, juvenile offenders are primarily involved in sex crimes or online fraud.

In 2021, China's criminal code was amended, gradually lowering the age of criminal responsibility. Under the new code, adolescents aged 16 and older can now be held criminally responsible for breaking the law , while teenagers between the ages of 14 and 16 may be charged with various criminal offenses, including murder, rape, assault resulting in death, robbery, extortion, and drug trafficking.

"It takes into account the current situation in China, where the age of maturity for minors has generally been lowered as living standards and educational levels have risen," writes Chen Zhijun, a law professor at the People's Public Security University of China. "This allows for regional and individual disparities in the development of minors' cognitive and self-control abilities to be taken into account."

body.zh: 中国云南省一名14岁少年被判故意杀人罪和强奸罪，被判处无期徒刑。受害者的家人认为他应该被判处死刑。 4月下旬，中国西南部云南省的一次不同寻常的法庭审判得出了一项具有里程碑意义的裁决，当地法院认定一名未成年人犯有故意杀人罪和强奸罪，并判处他无期徒刑。 案发时，被告人14岁。这是中国首次对未成年人判处如此严厉的刑罚。 法院裁定，有足够证据支持该案，即2025年夏天，被告在参加聚会回家的路上强奸了当时15岁的同学。为了防止罪行被发现，他随后将她勒死。 法官认为该罪行特别令人发指，并判处了最重的刑罚。据称，被告已认罪。 但受害人家属认为量刑过轻，准备上诉。 受害者的父亲对当地媒体表示：“我们仍然希望判处死刑，以便肇事者用自己的生命来偿还受害者的生命。”他呼吁“立即处决”。 受害人家属的代理律师周兆成表示，要求死刑“源于他们对失去女儿的深切绝望”。 从法律角度来看，受害人家属要求死刑的任何上诉似乎都注定会失败。根据中国法律，未成年人不得判处死刑，甚至不得判处死刑缓期执行。但这起案件在中国引起了震动，并引发了关于青少年、犯罪及其后果的辩论。 在中国，关于青少年犯罪的报道很少见。据官方新华社报道，青少年犯罪主要涉及性犯罪或网络诈骗。 2021年，中国修改刑法，逐步降低刑事责任年龄。根据新法，16岁及以上的青少年违法行为可被追究刑事责任，而14岁至16岁的青少年可能被指控犯有各种刑事犯罪，包括谋杀、强奸、殴打致人死亡、抢劫、敲诈勒索和贩毒。 “这是考虑到中国目前的情况，随着生活水平和教育水平的提高，未成年人的成熟年龄普遍降低，”中国人民公安大学法学教授陈志军写道。 “这考虑到了未成年人认知和自我控制能力发展的地区和个人差异。” 新规定还允许对……进行刑事起诉

reflection.en: This tragic news highlights the profound human struggle for justice in the face of heinous crimes, especially when a young life is involved. While the legal system has rendered a verdict, the victim's family's call for the death penalty reflects a deep longing for ultimate accountability and perhaps retribution. Micah 6:8 reminds us of the divine call to...
reflection.zh: 这则悲剧性的新闻凸显了面对滔天罪行时，人类对正义的深刻挣扎，尤其当涉及到一个年轻的生命时。尽管法律系统已作出判决，受害者家属呼吁判处死刑，反映出他们对最终问责和报复的深切渴望。弥迦书6:8提醒我们，雅伟要求我们“行公义，好怜悯”，这对于任何处理严重罪行的社会来说，都是一个充满挑战的平衡。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Former China defence ministers convicted of corruption in latest purge of military leaders
title.zh: 中国前国防部长因腐败被定罪，军事领导层最新一轮清洗

summary.en: Two former Chinese defence ministers, Li Shangfu and Wei Fenghe, have been sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve after being convicted of bribery. These are among the most severe sentences in a years-long purge of military leaders.
summary.zh: 中国前国防部长李尚福和魏凤和因受贿罪被判处死刑，缓期两年执行。这是多年来对军事领导人进行清洗中最为严厉的判决之一。

body.en: Ex-defence ministers, Li Shangfu and Wei Fenghe both sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve, among the most severe sentences in a years-long purge Two former Chinese defence ministers were given suspended death sentences for bribery on Thursday, after being convicted by China’s military court, in some of the most severe punishments to be handed down in a years-long purge of the military. Chinese state media Xinhua announced on Thursday that Li Shangfu and Wei Fenghe were both sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve, meaning that their sentences will probably be commuted to life imprisonment if Li and Wei demonstrate good behaviour. Continue reading...
body.zh: 前国防部长李尚福和魏凤和双双被判处死刑，缓期两年执行，这是长达一年的整肃行动中最严厉的判决之一。周四，两名前中国国防部长因受贿罪被中国军事法院定罪，被判处死刑缓期执行，这是多年来军队整肃行动中最严厉的一些处罚。中国官方媒体新华社周四宣布，李尚福和魏凤和双双被判处死刑，缓期两年执行，这意味着如果李尚福和魏凤和表现良好，他们的刑期可能会被减为无期徒刑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of former defence ministers for bribery highlights the destructive power of greed, which can lead even those in high office to severe consequences. This serves as a sober reminder that the pursuit of wealth above all else often results in profound personal and public grief.
reflection.zh: 前国防部长因受贿被定罪，凸显了贪婪的破坏力，即使身居高位者也可能因此面临严峻后果。这提醒我们，将财富置于一切之上，往往会带来深刻的个人和公共悲痛。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Crowds cheer China's new snooker star on return from championship win
title.zh: 人群欢呼中国斯诺克新星夺冠归来

summary.en: Wu Yize, 22, received a rock star's welcome upon his return to China after becoming the second-youngest player to win a world snooker title.
summary.zh: 22岁的吴宜泽在赢得世界斯诺克冠军后回到中国，受到了摇滚明星般的欢迎，成为史上第二年轻的世界冠军。

body.en:
Loud chanting and cheering rang around the room in the western Chinese city of Xi'an.

He waved modestly, wearing the expression of a shy 22-year-old not used to such sudden fame at home.

But that did not dampen the enthusiasm of those who had come to get a glimpse of someone on top of the world.

Earlier this week, a Chinese player won the World Snooker championship for the second year in a row, and it has captivated this country.

It is not only the repeat success driving this. It is also the fairytale story of a young man who dropped out of school aged 16 to move to Sheffield, England, in pursuit of a dream to turn professional.

He has now returned home as the second-youngest player ever to be crowned world champion.

The BBC asked Wu what he thought of so many fans turning out to see him. He replied with a gentle smile: "It's great to feel the warmth of my homeland."

The baby-faced snooker magician showed off some shots to the ooh-ing and ah-ing audience, including when he played one fan, Liu Yi fei. She had won an earlier play-off here to have a hit with him.

She said Wu's success had made her more determined to improve her own skills, and that this country expected to see plenty more like him in the future.

"In China, so many more people are playing," she said. "More pool halls are opening, and the sport is becoming ever more popular."

It is estimated that some 60 million people play billiards in China every year, in around 300,000 halls like the one in Xi'an.

The country is now churning out high-quality snooker competitors. They currently make up a quarter of all players on the professional circuit.

One eight-year-old boy told the BBC he was already pretty good himself: "One day, I'd like to be champion like Wu Yize."

One reason for China's snooker explosion is that it remains relatively cheap to play here.

It is a bonus for a sport in a city like Xi'an, which - like all of western China - has not enjoyed the same level of booming economic development as that in the country's south-east.

Even further to the west, Wu's home province of Gansu - known for its deserts - is less privileged again.

That he hails from such a region has fuelled the rags to riches aspect of his story.

Tales of him sharing a bed with his father in a flat with no windows as a teenager in Sheffield have made his victory seem sweeter, especially after he declared he would spend his prize money on a place for his parents to stay in England so they could support him.

Another fan, who came from Wu's home province and took hours to reach Xi'an via high-speed train, brought along a photo of the champion to get it signed.
body.zh: 在中国西部城市西安，房间里响起了大声的口号和欢呼声。 他谦虚地挥手，脸上的表情就像一个害羞的22岁年轻人，不习惯在家里突然出名。 但这并没有浇灭那些前来一睹世界之巅风采的人们的热情。 本周早些时候，中国选手连续第二年夺得斯诺克世界冠军，这让这个国家着迷。 这不仅仅是重复的成功推动的。这也是一个童话故事，讲述了一个16岁的年轻人为了追求成为职业球员的梦想而辍学搬到英国谢菲尔德的故事。 现在，他作为有史以来第二年轻的获得世界冠军的球员回到了家乡。 BBC询问吴对于这么多粉丝前来观看他有何看法。他温柔地笑着回答：“感受到家乡的温暖真是太好了。” 这位娃娃脸的斯诺克魔术师向现场观众展示了一些镜头，其中包括他扮演一位球迷刘亦菲的镜头。她早些时候在这里赢得了一场附加赛，与他一击。 她说，吴的成功让她更加坚定了提高自己技能的决心，并且这个国家希望未来能看到更多像他这样的人。 “在中国，有更多的人在玩，”她说。 “更多的台球馆正在开放，这项运动也变得越来越受欢迎。” 据估计，中国每年约有6000万人打台球，像西安这样的球馆约有30万个。 中国现在正在培养高素质的斯诺克选手。目前，他们占职业巡回赛所有球员的四分之一。 一名八岁男孩告诉BBC，他自己已经很不错了：“有一天，我想成为像吴宜泽一样的冠军。” 中国斯诺克运动蓬勃发展的原因之一是在这里打球的成本相对较低。 对于西安这样的城市来说，这是一项体育运动的福音，因为西安和中国西部地区一样，经济发展水平不及中国东南部地区。 再往西，吴的故乡甘肃省——以沙漠而闻名——的地位又不那么优越了。 他来自这样一个地区，这也助长了他白手起家的故事。 十几岁的时候，他在谢菲尔德与父亲在一套没有窗户的公寓里同住一张床的故事让他的胜利显得更加甜蜜，尤其是在他宣布将用奖金为父母在英格兰买一个住所，以便他们可以养活他之后。 另一位来自吴家乡的球迷，乘坐高铁花了几个小时才到达西安，他带来了一张冠军的照片来签名。

reflection.en: The enthusiastic welcome for Wu Yize highlights the immense pressure and scrutiny that often accompany public acclaim. Proverbs reminds us that just as precious metals are refined by fire, a person's character is truly tested by the praise and adulation they receive. May he navigate this new level of fame with grace and humility.
reflection.zh: 吴宜泽所受到的热烈欢迎，凸显了公众赞誉常伴随的巨大压力和审视。箴言提醒我们，正如贵金属在炉火中得以精炼，一个人的品格也通过他所获得的赞美和崇拜而受到真正的考验。愿他能以恩典和谦逊来应对这新的名声。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Two men first in British history to be found guilty of spying for China
title.zh: 两名男子在英国历史上首次被判为中国从事间谍活动罪名成立

Chi Leung “Peter” Wai, 38, and Chung Biu Yuen, 65, also known as Bill, were found guilty at the Old Bailey of assisting a foreign intelligence service, making them the first people in British history to be convicted of spying for China. reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了治理对人们生活产生的深远影响，尤其当国家权力被用于在其境外压制异议时。这些涉案人员被定罪，强调了权力被滥用时问责制的重要性，提醒我们真正的领导力在于服务所有人的福祉。

title.en: ‘They have built a machine that pulls out their mother tongue’: why Tibet’s children ‘think they are Chinese’
title.zh: “他们建造了一台机器，拔掉了他们的母语”：为什么藏族儿童“认为自己是中国人”

summary.en: Tibetan parents express concern that mandatory Mandarin instruction in schools is causing their children to lose their mother tongue and cultural identity from an early age. One mother reported her five-year-old stopped speaking Tibetan completely weeks after starting preschool.
summary.zh: 藏族家长表示，学校强制推行普通话教学，导致他们的孩子从小就失去母语和文化认同。一位母亲称，她五岁的孩子在入读幼儿园几周后，就完全停止说藏语了。

body.en: Parents say the insistence on Mandarin in schools is eroding the Tibetan language and culture right from early childhood Weeks after a Tibetan-speaking five-year-old started preschool, she had “completely stopped speaking Tibetan”, according to her mother. Nine months later, although the child could still understand Tibetan, she only answered in Mandarin, and at best a few single-word answers in Tibetan after some time. Instead the girl “keeps saying that she can only speak Chinese … that she is Chinese and not Tibetan”, according to a researcher who met the family. “The mother thinks that the daughter is just repeating what she is constantly told at school and that the government aims to eradicate Tibetan.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 家长们表示，学校坚持讲普通话正在侵蚀藏族语言和文化，据她的母亲说，一名说藏语的五岁孩子进入学前班几周后，她就“完全不再说藏语了”。九个月过去了，虽然孩子还能听懂藏语，但她只用普通话回答，一段时间后最多只能用藏语回答几个字。相反，据一位见过这家人的研究人员称，这名女孩“一直说她只会说中文……她是中国人，不是藏人”。 “母亲认为女儿只是在重复她在学校经常被告知的事情，政府的目标是消灭藏人。”继续阅读...

Deuteronomy 6:6-7 reminds us of the sacred task of passing on our deepest values and identity to the next generation, diligently teaching them in every aspect of life. verse.textZh: 我今日所吩咐你的话都要记在心上，也要殷勤教训你的儿女。无论你坐在家里，行在路上，躺下，起来，都要谈论。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher Jimmy Lai honored by DW
title.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英获德国之声表彰

summary.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher Jimmy Lai, who founded the city's largest pro-democracy newspaper, has been honored by DW. Lai is currently serving a 20-year prison sentence. His son stated that the award signifies that those who champion the freedom of others are not isolated in their efforts.
summary.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英被德国之声授予荣誉。黎智英曾创办香港最大的亲民主报纸，目前正在服20年监禁。他的儿子表示，这个奖项表明那些为他人自由而奋斗的人“从不孤单”。

body.en:
Before being imprisoned for 20 years, Jimmy Lai founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper. His son said the award shows that those who fight for the freedom of others "are never alone."

Arriving in Hong Kong as a penniless 12-year-old stowaway from southern China, Jimmy Lai sought only freedom and a future. At the time, Lai could never have imagined how his life would become forever intertwined with this former British colony.

"I'll sink with the ship, because this place gives me everything," said Lai in an interview about Hong Kong with DW a few months before he was taken into custody in December 2020. He was one of the first high-profile figures to be targeted under a "national security law" imposed on Hong Kong by Beijing following a crackdown on pro-democracy protests.

Beijing had said the law would restore Hong Kong "from chaos to order" after demonstrations in 2019 opposing an extradition bill morphed into massive protests against Beijing encroaching on Hong Kong's civil liberties .

Since then, the pro-democracy media mogul has spent nearly 2,000 days in solitary confinement in Hong Kong's maximum-security Stanley Prison.

Lai's years-long trial ended this February, when the 78-year-old was sentenced to 20 years in prison for "colluding with foreign forces." While he had pleaded not guilty to all charges, his legal team said he will not appeal.

The sentence is the heaviest punishment handed down so far under the national security law, and Lai's trial has symbolized for many people the severe erosion of press freedom in Hong Kong as part of Beijing's broader strategy to silence critical voices.

In recognition of his defense of press freedom and freedom of speech, DW has awarded Jimmy Lai with this year's Freedom of Speech Award.

Since 2015, the DW Freedom of Speech Award has honored journalists and human rights defenders as a way to call attention to restrictions on press freedom and concerning human rights situations around the world.

Sebastien Lai, Jimmy Lai's son and a longtime advocate for his release, told DW that "people who fight for freedom, people who fight for the freedom of others are never alone." And it's meaningful at a time when "a lot of media in Hong Kong now are self-censoring."

"I think if he knew about it [the award], he'd be very happy," Sebastien Lai said.             

DW Director General Barbara Massing said that with the award, DW is honoring Jimmy Lai's "indispensable dedication to democratic values."

title.en: Woman charged following alleged antisemitic incident at Sydney netball game
title.zh: 悉尼无板篮球赛涉嫌反犹事件后一女子被起诉

summary.en: Netball NSW said "antisemitism and discrimination of any kind have absolutely no place in our game and will not be tolerated".
summary.zh: 新南威尔士州无板篮球协会表示，“任何形式的反犹主义和歧视在我们的比赛中都绝对没有立足之地，也绝不能容忍”。

body.en:
The incident drew swift condemnation from netball groups. Source: Getty / Cavan Images

A woman has been charged following reports she allegedly made antisemitic comments while watching a children's netball game in Sydney's east.

Police were called to Heffron Park netball courts at Maroubra just after 10am on Saturday after reports of a woman making offensive comments towards a group of people.

The 42-year-old woman was reportedly at a junior game between Saints Netball Club and Maccabi Netball Club, a Jewish community club.

NSW Police issued a move-on direction at the game, and on Sunday charged the woman for using offensive language in a public place. She is expected to appear before Waverley Local Court on 17 June.

The charge carries a maximum penalty of a $660 fine or a community corrections order.

Netball NSW said the individual had been suspended from attending or participating in any netball activities while the matter was investigated.

"Everyone in our netball community deserves to feel safe, welcome and respected," it said in a statement.

"Antisemitism and discrimination of any kind have absolutely no place in our game and will not be tolerated."

"We commend Randwick Netball Association and Saints Netball Club for their swift response, including contacting police, engaging directly with those affected and strongly condemning antisemitic behaviour."

Saints Netball Club said in a statement on Saturday it was aware that a "supporter associated with our club" had allegedly made comments of an antisemitic nature.

"The Saints Netball Club unequivocally condemns and disavows antisemitism in all its forms. Such remarks do not reflect the values, principles or standards of our club, our members, our players, or our wider community," it said.

Adam Dinte, president of Maccabi Netball Club, told the Sydney Morning Herald the young girls in the team were deeply distressed after the incident.

"One of the girls in our team after the game told her mother that she wanted to take her uniform off because she didn’t want to be identified as Jewish, and didn't feel safe," he said.

The report occurred a day after the first week of hearings at the Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion concluded, with many witnesses testifying about their experiences with discrimination and hostility in public places.

Feeling unsafe to practice their religion publicly, particularly after the mass shooting that targeted a Hanukkah event at Bondi in December, was a common theme of the evidence given to Commissioner Virginia Bell.

body.zh: 这一事件迅速引起无板篮球团体的谴责。资料来源：盖蒂/卡万图片社 据报道，一名妇女在悉尼东部观看儿童无板篮球比赛时发表反犹太主义言论，因此受到指控。 周六上午 10 点刚过，警方接到报警称一名女子对一群人发表冒犯性言论，随后赶到马鲁布拉的赫夫隆公园无挡板篮球场。 据报道，这名 42 岁的女子当时正在观看圣徒无板篮球俱乐部和犹太社区俱乐部马卡比无板篮球俱乐部之间的青少年比赛。 新南威尔士州警方在比赛中发出了继续前进的指示，并于周日指控该女子在公共场所使用攻击性语言。她预计将于 6 月 17 日在韦弗利地方法院出庭。 该指控最高可处以 660 美元罚款或社区惩教令。 新南威尔士州无板篮球表示，在调查此事期间，该人已被暂停参加或参加任何无板篮球活动。 “我们无板篮球社区的每个人都应该感到安全、受欢迎和尊重，”它在一份声明中表示。 “任何形式的反犹太主义和歧视在我们的游戏中绝对没有地位，也不会被容忍。” “我们赞扬兰德威克无板篮球协会和圣徒无板篮球俱乐部的迅速反应，包括联系警方、直接与受影响的人接触以及强烈谴责反犹太主义行为。” 圣徒无板篮球俱乐部在周六的一份声明中表示，它知道一名“与我们俱乐部有关的支持者”据称发表了反犹太主义性质的评论。 “圣徒无板篮球俱乐部明确谴责和否认一切形式的反犹太主义。此类言论并不反映我们俱乐部、我们的会员、我们的球员或更广泛的社区的价值观、原则或标准，”它说。 马卡比无板篮球俱乐部主席亚当·丁特 (Adam Dinte) 告诉《悉尼先驱晨报》，球队中的年轻女孩在事件发生后深感悲痛。 “比赛结束后，我们队中的一个女孩告诉她的母亲，她想脱掉队服，因为她不想被认为是犹太人，而且感觉不安全，”他说。 该报告是在皇家反犹太主义和社会凝聚力委员会第一周听证会结束后的第二天发布的，许多证人就他们在公共场所遭受歧视和敌意的经历作证。 向弗吉尼亚·贝尔专员提供的证据中的一个共同主题是，感觉公开信奉自己的宗教是不安全的，特别是在去年 12 月邦迪光明节活动发生大规模枪击事件之后。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: This incident reminds us of the persistent need to treat all people with dignity and respect, regardless of their background. The ancient command to love the stranger as ourselves calls us to actively counter prejudice and ensure everyone feels safe and valued in our communities.
reflection.zh: 这起事件提醒我们，无论背景如何，都需要以尊严和尊重对待所有人。古老的诫命要求我们爱寄居的如同自己，这呼吁我们积极对抗偏见，确保每个人在我们的社区中都感到安全和被重视。

title.en: Could One Nation's Farrer victory be the 'beginning of the end' for the Coalition?
title.zh: 一国党在法勒选区获胜，这会是执政联盟的“终结开端”吗？

summary.en: The Farrer by-election delivered a historic result that could represent an "existential situation" for the Coalition.
summary.zh: 法勒补选产生了历史性结果，分析人士认为这可能对执政联盟构成“生存危机”。

body.en:
A historic by-election result in southern NSW may turn a new chapter Australian politics, after One Nation secured a resounding victory. Source: AAP / Bianca de Marchi

After nearly 80 years of Coalition representation, the voters of Farrer have decisively turned away from the major parties, delivering a result that could signal a seismic shift in Australian politics.

The regional New South Wales electorate on Saturday chose One Nation candidate David Farley to represent them in federal parliament, handing Pauline Hanson's populist right-wing party its first ever election victory for a lower house seat.

Farley, a 69-year-old agribusiness consultant who campaigned on water reform, regional cost-of-living pressures and anti-establishment politics, secured 39.4 per cent of the primary vote, defeating Climate-200-backed independent candidate Michelle Milthorpe, who received 28.4 per cent.

The Liberal primary vote collapsed by 31 per cent, with candidate Raissa Butkowski drawing just 12.4 per cent of the vote.

The two-candidate-preferred count gave One Nation 57.3 per cent, a stronger margin than former Liberal leader Sussan Ley achieved in the 2025 federal election.

Ley, who had held the seat for 25 years, triggered the by-election by resigning from parliament after she was ousted as party leader by Angus Taylor in February.

The result was seen as an ominous sign for the Coalition, which has struggled to regain its footing following its resounding 2025 federal election loss, multiple internal leadership changes and two splits in the National-Liberal coalition agreement .

Farley, speaking to cheering supporters on Saturday night, said One Nation had "reached the end of its beginning".

"We're going through the ceiling from here," he added, while Hanson said the party was "coming after those other seats".

Analysts have cautioned that by-elections can amplify protest voting and do not always translate directly to general election outcomes.

Even so, it was an historic result in a race that was widely viewed as a barometer for One Nation's ability to translate its year-long surge in the polls to electoral success.

Now that it's done so — what does it mean for the future of Australian politics?

Saturday's result reflects an "absolute repudiation of the Coalition", according to Benjamin Moffitt, a senior lecturer in politics and international relations at Monash University.

Moffitt said the swings against the Coalition appeared to go directly to One Nation — with a 33 per cent swing to One Nation, and 31 per cent away from the Coalition.

body.zh: 一国党取得压倒性胜利后，新南威尔士州南部的历史性补选结果可能会翻开澳大利亚政治的新篇章。资料来源：AAP / Bianca de Marchi 在担任联盟党代表近 80 年之后，法雷尔的选民果断地放弃了主要政党，这一结果可能标志着澳大利亚政治的巨大转变。 新南威尔士州地区选民周六选择一国党候选人大卫·法利在联邦议会中代表他们，这让宝琳·汉森领导的民粹主义右翼政党赢得了众议院席位的首次选举胜利。 法利是一位 69 岁的农业企业顾问，他的竞选主题包括水改革、地区生活成本压力和反建制政治，他获得了 39.4% 的初选选票，击败了气候 200 支持的独立候选人米歇尔·米尔索普 (Michelle Milthorpe)，后者获得了 28.4% 的选票。 自由党初选票数暴跌 31%，候选人 Raissa Butkowski 仅获得 12.4% 的选票。 两名候选人优先的计票结果显示，一国党得票率为 57.3%，比前自由党领袖苏珊·莱伊 (Sussan Ley) 在 2025 年联邦选举中获得的优势还要大。 担任该席位25年的莱伊在2月份被安格斯·泰勒(Angus Taylor)罢免党魁职务后，辞去了议会职务，引发了补选。 这一结果被视为联盟党的一个不祥之兆，在2025年联邦选举惨败、多次内部领导层变动以及国家自由党联盟协议两次分裂之后，该联盟一直在努力重新站稳脚跟。 法利在周六晚上对欢呼的支持者发表讲话时表示，一国党已经“走到了起点的终点”。 他补充说：“我们将从这里穿过天花板。”而汉森则表示，该党正在“追赶其他席位”。 分析人士警告说，补选可能会放大抗议投票，但并不总是直接转化为大选结果。 即便如此，这仍然是一场历史性的选举结果，这场选举被广泛视为一国党能否将其长达一年的民意调查激增转化为选举成功的晴雨表。 既然如此，这对澳大利亚政治的未来意味着什么？ 莫纳什大学政治和国际关系高级讲师本杰明·莫菲特表示，周六的结果反映出“对联盟党的彻底否定”。 莫菲特表示，反对联盟党的倾向似乎直接转向了一国党——33%的人倾向一国党，31%的人反对联盟党。 “换句话说，这里发生的事情并不神秘：一大群选民都表示他们厌倦了联盟党，他们将投票，至少在这次补选的情况下......

reflection.en: Political landscapes are constantly shifting, with parties rising and falling in influence. This news reminds us that while human efforts shape outcomes, ultimately, the power to lift up or bring down rests with a higher authority. It encourages us to look beyond immediate political fortunes to the enduring principles of governance and divine sovereignty.
